purpose: provide one high-level forecast interface combining joint continuous-circular state prediction, split-conformal joint uncertainty, environmental novelty and independent transfer scoring without collapsing them into one confidence number

data_roles.training: fits joint density model and environmental novelty reference only
data_roles.calibration: calibrates conformal prediction region only and must not refit the joint density or novelty model
data_roles.forecast: new context rows receiving state prediction, conformal region and novelty diagnostics
data_roles.validation: independent realized states used for density scoring or grouped transferability

row_output: time mode and model-based circular arc
height mean/scale at predicted time mode and model-based interval
Bonferroni conformal height interval x time arc
environmental novelty ratio/category and strict extrapolation flags

obligations: joint model training row count equals training split and excludes calibration rows
same-process test joint log-density gain is positive
same-process test coupling gain is positive
same-process Bonferroni joint empirical coverage lies between 0.88 and 0.93
at least 0.90 of bounded same-domain query rows are not strict extrapolation
all strongly shifted query rows are strict extrapolation
forecast rows expose no aggregate confidence score
